fusions.name: Plod and Thump
fusions.desc: A stamping heel that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You then move 15% faster for 3s.

fusions.name: Forced March Finish
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 30 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach of 7 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Steady Drove
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +10% per ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Walking It Off
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
